summary.title: Corporate CRM with External API
summary.description: Threat Model for Corporate CRM with External API Integration

threats.title: Spoofing
threats.description: Attacker uses stolen API key to impersonate a trusted partner and gain unauthorized access to CRM services.
threats.mitigation:
OAuth 2.0 authentication
Mutual TLS (mTLS)
API key rotation
IP allowlisting

threats.title: Denial of Service
threats.description: Large number of requests may overload the API Gateway and make CRM services unavailable.
threats.mitigation:
Rate limiting
Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Traffic filtering
Load balancing

threats.title: Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies requests before they reach the CRM application server.
threats.mitigation:
TLS encryption
Request signing
Input validation
Integrity checks

threats.title: Repudiation
threats.description: Users may deny performing actions if audit evidence is insufficient.
threats.mitigation:
Digitally signed audit logs
Immutable logging
Timestamped records

threats.title: Elevation of Privilege
threats.description: An attacker obtains administrator privileges and gains unauthorized access to CRM functions
threats.mitigation:
RBAC
Least privilege principle
Multi-factor authentication
Privilege monitoring

threats.title: Information Disclosure
threats.description: Sensitive customer information may be exposed to unauthorized parties.
threats.mitigation:
Data encryption
Access control
RBAC
Database auditing
